T: Jacob bakes. Queenie cooks. You eat.
D: A magizoologist arrives in 1926 New York and his case of magical creatures gets loose.
P: Serve dessert when Queenie magics up the apple strudel.
S: the pastries Jacob shapes like Newt's creatures
Puff pastry cut into little animal shapes, brushed with egg, sprinkled with cinnamon sugar and baked at 200C for 12 minutes.
the Blind Pig, the wizarding speakeasy
Devilled eggs and marinated olives on the bar, the eggs piped with mayo and mustard and dusted with paprika.
the niffler raiding the bank for anything shiny
Gold-wrapped chocolate coins tipped into a bowl with chunks of honeycomb and dark chocolate, for grabbing like a niffler.
M: the Goldstein sisters' apartment in New York
Beef chuck browned and braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrot and stock, potatoes added for the last hour.
Dumplings filled with potato and cheddar, boiled, then fried in butter with onion until golden, served with sour cream.
W: Apples, sultanas, cinnamon and breadcrumbs rolled in buttered filo, baked at 190C for 35 minutes, dusted with icing sugar, with cream.
K: Fresh lemonade with a splash of gin for the grown-ups, served in teacups to look innocent.

s.note: the pastries Jacob shapes like Newt's creatures
s.how: Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into little animal shapes with cutters or a knife. Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle generously with cinnamon sugar. Bake at 200C for 12 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool on a rack and arrange like a bakery window.

s.note: the Blind Pig, the wizarding speakeasy
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise and Dijon until smooth, then pipe back into the whites and dust with smoked paprika. Set out on the bar beside a bowl of green olives.

m.how: Boil and mash 600g potatoes, then mix with 150g grated cheddar. Fill dumpling wrappers and pinch closed. Boil for 3 minutes until they float, drain, then fry in butter with sliced onion until golden on both sides. Serve with sour cream.

w.how: Toss 4 sliced green apples with 80g sultanas, a teaspoon of cinnamon, sugar and a handful of breadcrumbs. Layer buttered filo sheets, spread the filling along one edge and roll up. Brush with butter and bake at 190C for 35 minutes. Dust with icing sugar.

d.how: Dissolve 100g sugar in a little hot water and cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a jug, add the syrup, plenty of ice and top with cold soda water. Pour into teacups so it looks innocent, adding a splash of gin to the cups for the grown-ups.
